# Vendor response fixtures (synthetic)

Synthetic responses shaped after the contracts in `connectors/CONTRACTS.md` (Huntress: official API reference; Atera:
OpenAPI v3 export, unverified against an account). **Not recorded from a live account** — no credentials were used and
every value (IDs, hostnames, people, subjects) is invented. Extra vendor fields and end-user contact data are included on
purpose: the tests prove they are ignored and never copied into Atlas.

Tenants: Huntress organization `7001`, Atera customer `5001` (Gasta); `7999` / `5999` play another MSP customer.
